x: Geoff North making a very welcome return to form took the first leg of 5½ miles and with a grand effort brought us home in 3rd place only 9 secs. behind the leader Ingleton of Ryde A.C. and barely yards behind Shergold of Portsmouth.
Despite running to form and pushing the leaders (Poly) well behind, Bill was dismayed to find that the fastest times were by Ellis (TVH) and Ingleton (Portsmouth).

Whether the journey by car (his wife was driving!) or the food at the Ridgeway Cafe near Marlborough was to blame we shall never know but what we do know was that we were back in 14th position one minute and twenty-five seconds behind Portsmouth who had taken the lead through a good run by Ingleton.
Since then Ingleton has joined them and,on his day, could well make the first 50. The two Cookes are both in trim again after lay-offs and should reach peak just at the right time.
